factories.name: newGetFormStep
factories.description: Read one form's items in form order, with each question's ID, title, type, and choices.

formId.description: FormID is the form ID, such as the formPicker unit's formId or the ID in https://docs.google.com/forms/d/FORM_ID/edit. It is also the form's Drive file ID.

factories.name: newListResponsesStep
factories.description: List one bounded page, 1 to 1000, of a form's responses, optionally only those submitted after a time, continued with Google's page token.

inputSchema.description: ListResponsesInput selects one page of a form's responses. Google documents no order for the listing, so read every page before treating a time as complete.

formId.description: FormID is the form ID, such as the formPicker unit's formId.

pageSize.description: PageSize is 1 to 1000 responses; zero uses the connection's responsePageSize.

pageToken.description: PageToken continues a listing with its NextPageToken; blank reads the first page. Google requires the same form and filter as the request that returned the token.

submittedAfter.description: SubmittedAfter keeps responses submitted after, but not at, this time with Google's "timestamp > N" filter; zero has no lower bound.

submittedAtOrAfter.description: SubmittedAtOrAfter keeps responses submitted at or after this time with Google's "timestamp >= N" filter; zero has no lower bound. Set at most one of the two times.

factories.name: newGetResponseStep
factories.description: Read one form response by its response ID, with every answer keyed by question ID.

inputSchema.description: GetResponseInput identifies one response of one form.

formId.description: FormID is the form ID, such as the formPicker unit's formId.

responseId.description: ResponseID is the response ID, such as a FormResponse ResponseID from listResponses.
